artworks.title: Un amateur difficile
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man seated at a table, cutting food on a plate. He has a stern expression and is dressed in a suit with a white shirt. There is a wine glass on the table. Other people in formal wear are around the table, engaged in various activities. In the background, a crowd stands before a gallery wall with framed artworks.

artworks.title: C'est tout d'même flatteur d'avoir
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two people standing side by side. The man is on the left and the woman is on the right. The man has one arm across his chest, holding what appears to be another arm with a gloved hand. He has a large, round nose, wide mouth, prominent eyes, curly hair, and wears a suit with a vest and bow tie. The woman is close next to him with a bonnet on her head and her face turned towards the man. She wears a jacket tied around her neck. A large framed portrait of a person resembling the man is visible on the wall behind them, along with other smaller framed artworks.

artworks.title: J'aimerais autant voir un ouragan se promener dans mon jardin qu'une de ces satanées crinolines!
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a woman in a garden setting. The woman is to the left, with a large crinoline-style skirt partially obscuring her body. Her back is turned, with her hair styled in an updo. She wears a form-fitted bodice. The man is on the right, facing towards the woman with hands clasped behind his back. He wears a checkered suit and a hat, with a stern expression. The background includes trees and foliage. The scene has a sketch-like quality.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Mrs. Benjamin Ogle Tayloe, 1879)
artworks.description: The image depicts two men in a medieval setting. On the left, a man is seated on a stone bench next to a small dog, playing a wind instrument. He wears a blue tunic, red footwear, and white stockings. The man on the right is dressed as a jester in a colorful outfit with a hood, holding a stick. They are below a stone archway next to a partially open wooden door leading to a room with stone walls and an ornate window. Ivy climbs the exterior wall, contributing to the historic ambiance. Above the archway are ornate block letters and text in an old-fashioned typeface.

artworks.title: Bronzes
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a detailed drawing of a lion in the upper left corner. The upper right section features ornate vases and decorative plates. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and white. In the center, the lion is shown with its paw on a small object, with vases and plates behind it. Below, a knight's helmet and other intricate decorations are visible along the left edge.

artworks.title: Devant le tableau de M. G. Moreau
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group scene of four people, with their entire upper bodies visible. They are standing closely together, facing forward. The person on the left has distinct facial features with a long face and a somewhat worried expression, and they are wearing a bonnet and high-collared attire. The person next to them has a sharp nose and an inquisitive look, shown in profile, wearing a tall top hat and a dark coat. The third person, central in the image, appears older with round glasses, heavy eyebrows, and wears another tall hat, holding a book or pamphlet. Beside him, a female figure with prominent eyes looks forward, wearing a similar high-collared dress and hat. The background consists of a framed artwork or murals on the walls.

artworks.title: Kaatskill Fall; and In the Kaatskill Clove
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Kate Bunner, wife of the artist, 1902)
artworks.description:
The image shows two pencil sketches on a single sheet. The upper sketch depicts a landscape view of a waterfall cascading over a rocky cliff. The view is slightly elevated, showing the waterfall flowing down to a collection of rocks below, with a small human figure for scale. The horizon aligns with the hills and distant treetops. The strokes capture textures of the rocks and the flow of water, using shades of gray. 

The lower sketch portrays a dense forest scene with leafy trees extending towards the viewer. Fallen logs and boulders are shaded and detailed, giving depth. The horizon is obstructed by thick foliage. The color palette is shades of gray. Both sketches depict natural scenes through pencil work.

artworks.title: Ah! Ma pauv' Madame Chaffarou ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two cloaked figures under an abstract depiction of celestial events. The image features two cloaked figures positioned in the center, engaged in a concerned gesture, as they seem to speak to each other. To their right, there is a fantastical depiction of a comet taking the form of a dragon's head, with sunbeams radiating from it. To their left, a cone-shaped object appears, also emitting light. The style is reminiscent of caricature or satire, with exaggerated facial expressions conveying urgency or anxiety. The drawing combines elements of realism and fantasy to convey themes of cosmic events and human reaction.

artworks.title: Plaisanterie que se permettent ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse standing upright at a doorway. The horse has its front legs inside a building, creating the illusion that it has entered through the door. The horse has an exaggerated expression, with its mouth open, as it looks into the room. The background shows a cityscape view through a window. The interior features textured walls, and the drawing style includes meticulous line work typical of printed illustrations from the 19th century. Textual elements suggest it was intended for printing, and the caption at the bottom provides context for the image.

artworks.title: Below Fawn's Leap, Catskill Mountains; and Above the Bridge
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Kate Bunner, wife of the artist, 1902)
artworks.description:
The image contains two pencil sketches of natural landscapes. The top sketch shows a rocky cliff, rolling hills in the distance, and a valley horizon. The strokes are soft and use light shading to depict the scene in shades of gray. 

The bottom sketch features a wooden bridge over a calm stream, with a tall tree in the background. The pencil strokes are detailed, capturing the textures of rocks, wood, and water. The gray tones unify the sketches, emphasizing the serene natural setting.

artworks.title: Ils m'ont refusé ca ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two figures are present in the image. The foreground figure is a man wearing a wide-brimmed hat and coat, holding a framed picture of a candle in a candlestick. There is a second figure in the background carrying a large frame. The image is predominantly in shades of gray and black. The man in the foreground is centrally positioned and facing forward, while the background figure is positioned to the left. Both figures are set against a sketchy backdrop depicting trees and shadowy silhouettes.

artworks.title: Plate Number 535. Movement of the hand, beating time
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, 1887)
artworks.description: This is a photograph showing a series of sequential images of a hand in different positions and gestures. The image features a grid layout with multiple small frames, each showing a close-up of an arm and hand. The background and lighting are consistent, and the series captures various dynamic hand movements. The tones are monochromatic with strong contrast, highlighting the skin and drapery texture. The composition suggests a study of movement or a kinetic experiment, emphasizing hand gestures' fluidity and versatility.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Fountain
artworks.medium: graphite with pen and black ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of J.O. La Gorce, 1952)
artworks.description: The image features a rustic landscape with a horizon bordered by trees and an ancient bridge. A figure stands on one of the bridge's structures. On the right side, there is an ornate stone fountain with intricate carvings and a classical urn on top, set on a rocky hill. The sketch is detailed with fine pencil strokes depicting stone and foliage textures. The color scheme is monochromatic in various shades of gray, emphasizing line work and shading.

artworks.title: Bear Stung by Bees
artworks.medium: pen and black ink over graphite on paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a bear reclining next to several beehives. A bear is lying on its back with one paw touching its head, appearing relaxed. Some beehives are placed on a bench, with one hive overturned. The background includes thick foliage and a wooden fence, creating a tranquil setting. The drawing features fine lines to depict various textures such as fur, wood, and leaves, capturing a peaceful moment in a natural setting.

artworks.title: Half Dome and Royal Arches, Yosemite, from Glacier Point
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on gray wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase through a gift of Ralph Cross Johnson, 1980)

artworks.title: Study for "Westward the Course of Empire Takes Its Way"
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Rear Admiral E.H.C. Leutze, son of the artist, 1917)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people in an outdoor setting. The drawing depicts several individuals gathered together against a rocky backdrop. In the center, there is a figure in a large hat and ornate clothing, pointing or gesturing towards the right side of the piece. Beside them, there are two figures seated; one holds an infant. In the background, the angular lines suggest a rocky terrain or mountainous region.

artworks.title: Clear Creek Canyon, Rocky Mountains, Colorado
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on wove paper mounted to board
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Membership Association Fund, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a mountainous landscape with a canyon seen from an elevated perspective. The mountains dominate the upper part of the image with loose and sparse lines indicating the contours and textures. The artist uses minimalistic and gestural brushstrokes, and a muted color palette of soft browns and grays. There are hints of vegetation and rocks in the foreground leading to steep, rocky formations. In the distance, the mountains seem to converge, possibly suggesting a pathway or river. The scene evokes a sense of untouched nature.

artworks.title: Dans la galerie du Louvre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two scenes in cultural locations in Paris. One scene shows individuals in an art gallery, possibly the Louvre, with one individual painting and others observing. The second scene shows a comedic interaction at a zoo or botanical garden, with people observing caged animals, including a big cat. The drawing includes exaggerated human and animal expressions, figures in top hats and elegant attire, and text accompanying the images.

artworks.title: Gondola, Evening in Venice
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of  Mrs. Eugene Vail, wife of the artist, 1948)
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape along a waterway. The lighting is subdued, and the focus is on buildings alongside the water. The horizon is not visible, and details are obscured by mist and low light. The artwork uses soft strokes and a grayscale color palette for an ethereal quality. A boat is seen on the water in the foreground, leading the eye to the shadowy buildings in the background.

artworks.title: Study for "Happy Would Be the Men of the Fields, If They Knew Their Good Fortune"
artworks.medium: charcoal and graphite on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Maj. Ferry K. Heath, 1934)
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic drawing of a person in a stepping position. The individual has a focused expression with defined features, short hair, and a hat. They are dressed in draped fabric, revealing parts of the upper body, and wearing sandals. One hand holds a spear, while the other grips the fabric above the head. The background has sketched grid lines.

artworks.title: View of Streatley-on-Thames
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Lady Inchyra, 1962)
artworks.description: The image shows a view over a landscape from an elevated vantage point. Rolling meadows, a river, clusters of trees, distant hills, and a small bridge over the river can be seen. The brushstrokes are soft and fluid, creating a harmonious atmosphere. The color palette consists of gentle earth tones and muted blues, evolving into sandy shades towards the horizon.

artworks.title: Group of Many Figures
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 2 13/16 x 11 1/4 in. (7.14 x 28.58 cm)
other (French mat): 10 x 16 7/8 in. (25.4 x 42.86 cm)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd of silhouetted figures. The image features numerous figures rendered in brown ink, with a focus on their outlines and gestures rather than detailed features. The figures are depicted in various poses, suggesting movement and interaction among them. The composition is dynamic, with a central figure appearing to extend an arm or hold an object. The drawing uses light and shadow effectively to create a sense of depth and a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Fishermen
artworks.medium: graphite and black and gray wash, heightened with white gouache on brown wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Edward C. and Mary Walker Collection, 1937)
artworks.description: The image features four men seated around a table in a casual gathering. The men are engaged in conversation. One man on the left is smoking a pipe, wearing a jacket and a hat. Beside him, another man is visible in profile, wearing a cap. The third man has short curly hair and is leaning over the table. The man on the right has a beard and a hat, looking towards the others. The chairbacks have different designs. In the background, faint outlines of additional individuals are visible in a neutral brown backdrop.

artworks.title: Schwabelweiss
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a village scene viewed from a low vantage point near a water's edge. A row of small, closely packed buildings and a church with an onion-shaped dome are prominently featured. There are gentle slopes leading towards the structures. The image uses fine, detailed line work to depict texture and depth in the buildings and natural landscape. The lines are delicate and varied, creating a sense of detail and softness. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark ink on a pale background, resulting in a classic and timeless feel.
